title: Adopt Minimal..Immaculate housekeeping levels with a separate scope axis
description: User ruling 2026-09-27 replaces C1 Tidy..C5 Clean room with Minimal, Light, Standard (default), Deep, Immaculate (housekeeping_level). Project housekeeping only, not code improvement. Immaculate = deep housekeeping plus verified disposition of every in-scope item: nothing left unattended, not nothing left on disk. Depth never silently widens scope: scope (session|repo|machine) is its own setting; machine-wide purges only at machine scope.

acceptanceCriteria.text: docs spec and an ADR define the five levels, the scope axis, and Immaculate as verified disposition
hk accepts --level minimal|light|standard|deep|immaculate and --scope session|repo|machine, and plans no machine-scope item unless scope is machine, proven by a unit test
every skill, the /clean command, README and .housekeeping example use the new names; no C1-C5 names remain outside history
an Immaculate pass produces a disposition for every in-scope inventory item
